visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with dark hair and white clips is lying back. Her face has a very shiny, wet-look texture. She uses her fingers to slowly peel a transparent, dried film off her nose and forehead, showing very reflective skin beneath. (2) Close-ups of her face focus on the extreme glossiness of her cheek and forehead. Multiple chat bubble overlays in Traditional Chinese appear on the left side of the frame, representing customer testimonials. (3) The scene shifts to a brighter indoor setting where she is wearing a black tank top and a gold watch. She holds a tube of product and uses a white silicone brush to apply a thick, white cream across her cheeks and forehead in smooth strokes. (4) In a darker, low-light environment, she peels a large section of the now-transparent mask from her chin and jawline. The film is stretchy and clear. (5) She is shown again with a purple headband, smiling and gesturing towards her bright, glowing face from several angles. The background is a clean, modern indoor room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly female narrator speaks in Traditional Chinese over a light, upbeat synth-pop instrumental track. The voice is clear and welcoming. (2) Several digital 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects trigger as visual text messages appear on screen, emphasizing the social proof. (3) Subtle rustling or 'swishing' sounds are audible as the cream is applied to the skin with a brush. The BGM maintains a steady, rhythmic energy. (4) A textured 'peel' sound effect coincides with the visual removal of the clear mask, punctuating the transformation. (5) The narrator concludes with a warm seasonal wish, and the BGM fades out naturally following her final sentence.
